release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.1.4

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice. Tesseract and Labels are inside the program folder.

Rotate: A turned page keeps its trim. Multi-up and Booklet pack on that trim, and Autoscale crop marks sit on the trim after a rotate. Photos and the long bleed strips stay the page image in the built PDF.

Booklet: The pages meet on the trim at the center bind. Bleed stops at the middle of the gutter and does not cross onto the other page.

Multi-up: A negative gutter is split in half at the touching edge. The next page no longer covers the previous page across the whole overlap.

Recipe: Grow Bleed, Rotate, Resize, Crop, and Color open on a double-click or a right-click, with the saved settings filled. A single click still previews the line. Deleting the line under a Grow Bleed step no longer opens the Bleed window. Grow Bleed still does not open Multi-up.
